    Properties of the quotient construction F₁ #

    For the functor F₁ = Q.functor of Construction 3.3:

    • relMap_injective: v ↦ s ⊗ a(v) + t ⊗ b(v) is injective on D;
    • mem_relSub_iff: the relation submodule is the k-range of relMap (the remark after Construction 3.3);
    • map_injective_of_shortExact, map_surjective_of_shortExact, range_eq_ker_of_shortExact: F₁ is exact on D;
    • finite_obj: F₁ preserves finite dimension;
    • topQ, topQ_eq_zero_iff, topEquiv: the top F₁(T)/J F₁(T) is W;
    • map_injective: F₁ is faithful on D (Lemma 3.4).

    Two hypotheses on the idempotents are used where needed, both in the form TopOneDim k e : Λ e ⊆ k e + J. They hold for primitive idempotents of a basic algebra over an algebraically closed field (Setting 3.2): then Λ e / J e is the simple module S_e, which is one-dimensional, spanned by the image of e.

    radPow M i is the additive subgroup J^i M generated by products j₁ ⋯ jᵢ • m with all j_l ∈ J.
